about: The falsifier: at 299 three spawns in lane B's code passed [...process.execArgv] to their child. Lane D found what that does at the capsule host: a comparison driven by node -e rendered a page, each capsule child re-ran the -e script, which asked the capsule again, 30 processes in 7 minutes before they were killed. A pass driven the same way would have started an observer or a measure that re-ran the driver.
